title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 7. Notes the overall limited progress and underinvestment in the development of a common European defence capability, industrial capacity and defence readiness since the CSDP’s establishment 25 years ago; notes that despite the ambition of framing a common Union defence policy, as laid out in Article 42(2) TEU, concrete steps are still missing, most importantly adequate investment in defence by individual Member States;
